title: [Soup´s] Tweaked Tools
description: Slightly tweaks some of the tools to discern them more.
body:
This texture pack makes some smaller changes to _most_ tools, but not all of them. The changes are very small, only there to discern the starter tools from the mid — and late — game tools and weapons; trying to keep them as vanilla as possible.

As of the moment, this texture pack is **vanilla only** ´^`"

Inspired by works such as https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/tools-recrafted and others!
